notes.text: Every class advances at Lv 10 (Magicians too) and Lv 30. A job gets 1 SP at advancement and 3 a level: 61 SP for 1st job (Lv 10–30) and 121 for 2nd job (Lv 30–70). 2nd-job SP stops at Lv 70 even though the launch runs to Lv 100, as it did in COT #2, where the points from Lv 70 on went to 3rd job.
2nd-job SP can't go into 1st-job skills (meowdb; mapleclassic.wiki's Skill points page says otherwise). AP and SP Reset Scrolls are in the Cash Shop data; launch prices aren't out.

notes.text: HP and MP per level are fixed by class and INT adds no MP, so there is nothing to gain from HP washing.
Every class can crit (5% base rate, +20% crit damage). Most area attacks stop at 4 monsters; Thunder Bolt and Slow reach 6.
Accuracy scales with level and spells can miss, so mages need some accuracy too (one older wiki page still says magic never misses).
Sources disagree on 1st-job stat minimums (none, or the old 35 STR / 20 INT / 25 DEX). Check in game on Oct 6 before you spend AP.

weapons.why: Strongest Fighter swing multiplier (3.0x swing / 2.0x stab); meowdb measured axes ~3-5% ahead of swords in average damage at Lv 30 and 70 even before Axe Mastery's bleed (a monster carries only one bleed at a time, per meowdb). 3 of the 4 public Lv 100-120 Crusader builds use axes (Grummash, Skeptik, Thorn; Meteo uses a sword). Lv 70 target: Chrono (93 W.ATK).

Fixed 2.5x multiplier gives tight damage rolls, so guaranteed one-hit kills come earlier while leveling, and Sword Mastery adds +90 WDEF. COT2 tester Wild's choice; Scimitar/Lion's Fang/Sparta/Doombringer have the longest sword reach (102 px avg).
Shield Guard plus 100% Power Guard reflection on guarded hits. Costs ~9% single-target DPS but raises Lv 70 physical EHP from ~4,010 to ~6,500 (meowdb benchmark).

builds.summary: At launch this branch is played as a Fighter all the way to Lv 100: an MP-efficient sword-or-axe bruiser with the party Rage buff and a 3-target Final Attack. Crusader, its COT2-only 3rd job, banks a combo orb on every normal hit and cashes the orbs in with Panic (one target) or Coma (up to four) for up to double damage; testers found it strong but short-ranged and repetitive.

mobbing.why: Launch: Fighter posted the highest Lv 70 AoE DPS of all ten 2nd jobs (9,235, meowdb) thanks to Slash Blast plus a 3-target Final Attack, held back only by ~150 px melee reach. COT2 preview: Crusader's Coma (4 mobs) and Shout (6) add orb-based AoE but are short-ranged, so roughly unchanged.

bossing.why: Launch: 2nd-highest single-target DPS of the ten Lv 70 builds (4,390, behind only Bandit), with Rage up and Final Attack toggled off against single targets. COT2 preview: Panic at 5 orbs (320% x2.0) plus Armor Crash zeroing boss DEF would push this to about 5.

mobility.why: Launch: Rush (dash, 1 s cooldown) is the only movement skill, which meowdb rates 3/5 - better than Bowmen, behind Thieves and Teleport mages. COT2 preview: Crusader adds no movement while other 3rd jobs gain Flash Jump/Wind Step, so it would slip to about 2 in relative terms.

survival.why: Launch: Warrior HP (+350 Max HP per advancement) but the 2H build has no shield (~4,010 physical EHP at Lv 70, 7th of 10) and Rage lowers your own WDEF by 40; a 1H + shield setup reaches ~6,500. COT2 preview: Power Guard's damage reflection would nudge it toward 4.

funding.why: Launch: the best Damage/MP of all ten Lv 70 builds (264 per MP), Final Attack costs no MP and the weapons are common shop/craft items; HP potions from face-tanking are the main cost. COT2 preview: Combo Attack and Coma's HP/MP costs would bring it to about 4.

party.why: Launch: Rage gives nearby party members +40 Attack Power (~8% more physical damage, nothing for magic); no other party tools. COT2 preview: Armor Crash setting mobs' physical DEF to 0 would lift it to about 4.

stats.rule: Raise DEX only to your next weapon's requirement (DEX on gear counts; 70 total covers every Lv 70 weapon) and put every other AP into STR.

plan.do: No dice in Classic World: every stat starts at 4 and you place 9 AP at creation. Put all 9 into STR (13/4/4/4), then all 5 AP per level into STR (58 STR at Lv 10; meowdb's sample starts 12/5/4/4 and reaches 57 STR / 5 DEX). Beginner SP is 1 per level (9 by Lv 10): Three Snails, Recovery and Nimble Feet at 3 each. The Warrior advancement has no stat requirement.

Mostly STR (about 4 STR / 1 DEX per level), adding DEX only for weapon checkpoints: ~18 base DEX at Lv 20 and ~27 at Lv 30 so a +3 DEX helmet reaches the Blue Axe's 30 DEX (meowdb sample: 135 STR / 27 DEX at Lv 30).
+3 STR / +2 DEX for Lv 31-36, then +4 STR / +1 DEX until 60 base DEX (~Lv 57), then pure STR: ~302 STR / 60 DEX base at Lv 70, with ~10 DEX from gear for Chrono/Doombringer's 70 DEX requirement.
All STR; total DEX stays at 70 (meowdb's planner caps weapon DEX needs at 70 after Lv 70; public Lv 100-120 COT2 builds sit at ~504-617 STR / 70 DEX).

variants.name: 2H Sword Fighter/Crusader
variants.how: Make swords your main family (Sword Mastery, Sword Booster and Final Attack: Sword in place of the axe skills); same AP plan. 2nd-job SP stops at Lv 70, so only one family gets maxed.
variants.tradeoff: ~3-5% less average damage and no bleed, but tighter rolls make guaranteed one-hit kills easier while leveling and Sword Mastery adds +90 WDEF (Wild's COT2 pick).

variants.name: 1H + Shield
variants.how: One-handed sword or axe with Red Cross Shield, later Gold Ancient Shield, scrolled with Shield DEF Lesser scrolls.
variants.tradeoff: ~9% less single-target DPS, but ~6,500 vs ~4,010 physical EHP at Lv 70; in 3rd job Power Guard reflects 100% of shield-guarded hits.

variants.name: Low-DEX
variants.how: Keep base DEX minimal, cover weapon requirements with DEX on gear, and fix misses with helmet/cape Accuracy scrolls (Levi's Dexless Warrior guide on the meowdb forum: about 21 base DEX by Lv 30, then an AP reset toward 4 DEX; Wild's advice).
variants.tradeoff: More STR, but weapon upgrades can force gear swaps or a Cash Shop AP Reset.

skillInfo.what: HP regenerates every 10 s even while moving; potion HP healing +5% to +20%.
skillInfo.classicChange: Per its Classic World text it now works while moving and boosts potion healing; the original only regenerated while standing still (pre-BB fallback, not confirmed for Classic World).

skillInfo.what: +10% to +25% of base Max HP (requires Improved HP Recovery 3).
skillInfo.classicChange: Now an immediate % of base HP instead of extra HP per level/AP, so late points lose nothing and HP washing is gone (meowdb, MetaRoad).

skillInfo.what: +5 to +20 Accuracy and +1% to +5% Critical Rate.
skillInfo.classicChange: Classic World addition to the Warrior book; not part of the original 1st-job skill set (pre-BB fallback).

skillInfo.what: +5% to +25% Weapon DEF for 300-600 s, 15 MP (requires Max HP Increase 3).
skillInfo.classicChange: Cut from +30% (COT1/early previews) to +25% in COT2 (meowdb skill changes, MetaRoad).

skillInfo.what: 160% to 260% damage to 1 target, 4-12 MP; uses your weapon's normal reach.
70% to 130% to up to 4 mobs, costs 3-8 HP and 4-12 MP; reach 130 px, 150 px from Lv 11 (requires Power Strike 1).
skillInfo.classicChange: 4-target cap: Classic World cut most area attacks from 6 targets to 4 (MetaRoad).

skillInfo.what: Sword mastery 1 to 10 plus +30 to +90 Weapon DEF while a sword is equipped.
skillInfo.classicChange: No Accuracy bonus any more (MetaRoad); COT2 raised its WDEF value from 20 to 90 (meowdb).

skillInfo.what: Axe mastery 1 to 10 plus a 5% to 25% chance to bleed for 40% to 100% of the hit over 3 s (bleed ignores DEF and can crit).
skillInfo.classicChange: The bleed is new and the Accuracy bonus is gone (MetaRoad).

skillInfo.what: Toggle: 20% to 50% chance after an attack skill to hit up to 3 mobs for 110% to 140%; sword only; no MP cost (requires Sword Mastery 3).
skillInfo.classicChange: Now a toggle that only fires when a target is in range; COT2 raised the proc 35% to 50% and cut damage 180% to 140% (meowdb).

skillInfo.what: Toggle: 20% to 50% chance to hit up to 3 mobs for 110% to 140%; axe only; no MP cost (requires Axe Mastery 3).
skillInfo.classicChange: Same COT2 change as the sword version: 50% proc, 140% damage (meowdb).

skillInfo.what: +2 attack-speed stages with swords for 100-300 s; costs 30 to 10 HP and MP (requires Sword Mastery 5).
+2 attack-speed stages with axes for 100-300 s; costs 30 to 10 HP and MP (requires Axe Mastery 5).
Party: +10 to +40 Attack Power and -10 to -40 Weapon DEF for 150-300 s, 10-25 MP; area grows at Lv 16.
skillInfo.classicChange: Buffs the new Attack Power stat, which counts double in Classic World's damage formula (MetaRoad); COT2 raised it from +35 to +40 and the WDEF penalty to -40 (meowdb).

skillInfo.what: Dash 130 (150 at Lv 10) forward, hitting up to 4 mobs for 60% to 80% and knocking them back; you can't be knocked back mid-dash; 1 s cooldown, 40 to 20 MP.
skillInfo.classicChange: Moved into the 2nd-job slot Power Guard held in COT1 (originally a 4th-job skill, per pvpbank/MMOexp). Official Aug 11 COT2 patch: cooldown 3 s to 1 s, MP 30-10 changed to 40-20 (MetaRoad's planner still lists the pre-patch 30-10).

skillInfo.what: +3 to +22 extra MP every 10 s.
Toggle: every non-finisher hit adds an orb (max 3, 4 from Lv 11, 5 from Lv 21); +5% to +20% damage while at least 1 orb is held; 55 to 25 MP.
skillInfo.classicChange: Flat +5-20% bonus with any orbs held; COT2 testers felt this was weaker than the original orbs (community sentiment, not verified).

skillInfo.what: Spends orbs: 230% to 320% to 1 target with a 40% to 100% chance of Darkness (lower ACC) for 5-9 s; reach 64-127 px; orb bonus is 5 x orbs x (orbs - 1)%, i.e. x1.0/1.1/1.3/1.6/2.0 for 1-5 orbs (MetaRoad planner, matches Wild's tests).
skillInfo.classicChange: One skill for both swords and axes (the original had separate sword/axe versions - pre-BB fallback).

skillInfo.what: Spends orbs: 100% to 160% to up to 4 mobs in front (130-150 px) with the same orb bonus as Panic; bleed chance +20 points per orb spent, bleed deals 40% to 100% over 3 s; costs 8-16 HP and 12-20 MP.
skillInfo.classicChange: Single sword/axe skill that bleeds instead of stunning (the original's stun is pre-BB fallback).

skillInfo.what: 20% to 50% to up to 6 mobs around you (400x300 px at max), 70% to 100% chance to add 2 orbs, Evasion -2 to -4 for 5-10 s; any weapon.
skillInfo.classicChange: Now an orb generator and Evasion debuff that keeps the 6-target cap (MetaRoad); no stun any more (pvpbank, low trust).

skillInfo.what: Debuff: sets the physical DEF of 2 to 4 nearby mobs to 0 for 8-15 s; 50 to 30 s cooldown (requires Improved MP Recovery 3).
skillInfo.classicChange: Zeroes defense outright rather than cancelling defense buffs (original behaviour is pre-BB fallback); a COT2 tester reports Crash debuffs from different jobs overwrite each other.

skillInfo.what: Reflects 20% to 40% of physical damage taken (100% if a shield guards the hit), capped at 10% of the mob's Max HP per reflect; 80-180 s (requires Armor Crash 3).
skillInfo.classicChange: Moved from Fighter/Page 2nd job (COT1) to Crusader/White Knight 3rd job in COT2 (meowdb).

gear: 2H weapon ladder (axe / sword): Lv 30 Blue Axe 50 / Scimitar 53, Lv 40 Sabretooth (Weaponcrafting 8) / Zard, Lv 50 The Rising (Weaponcrafting 10) / Lion's Fang, Lv 60 The Shining / Sparta, Lv 70 Chrono / Doombringer (93 W.ATK each) - meowdb Fighter guide.

1H option: Fireman's Axe or Gladius at Lv 30 up to Mikhail or Red Katana at Lv 70, with Red Cross Shield (110 WDEF, 18% guard) then Gold Ancient Shield (192 WDEF, +35 HP, 27.7% guard); guard = shield WDEF / (shield WDEF + 500), minimum 5% (MetaRoad planner).
Scroll gloves for W.ATK, not Critical Rate: ~5% more expected damage vs ~1.25% for five Lesser scrolls (meowdb); Wild agrees because orb damage scales off W.ATK.

Fix accuracy with helmet and cape Accuracy scrolls before adding DEX (Wild); Grummash's Lv 70 reference set uses a Mithril Planet hat with 7 Hat ACC Lesser scrolls, Red Gaia Cape, Bronze Platine top/bottom, Bronze Husk gloves and Metal Silver Earrings.
Overalls are the only body slot that takes STR/DEX scrolls (Lesser +1 at 100%); tops and bottoms have none in the current data (meowdb).
Lemons (150 MP for 150 mesos) tie Oranges for the best MP per meso and restore three times as much per use; Nexon's COT2 report lists Lemon as the top-selling item (3.5M).
strengths: Fighter had the best Damage/MP (264) and the highest AoE DPS of all ten Lv 70 2nd-job benchmarks (meowdb).
Rage is a real party buff: +40 Attack Power, worth about 8% more Power Strike damage.
Axe builds add Axe Mastery bleed (ignores defense, can crit); Coma also bleeds in 3rd job, but a monster carries only one bleed at a time (the stronger replaces the weaker, per meowdb).
In COT2, Panic at 5 orbs gave the largest single-target burst in the Warrior line and Armor Crash zeroed defense for the party.
weaknesses: Short reach and only Rush for mobility; no vertical movement.
No party HP buff, no shield on the 2H build, and Rage lowers your own WDEF.
Crusader's finishers are short (Panic 64-127 px, Coma 130-150 px) and a whiff wastes the orbs.
COT2 testers found the build-then-spend combo loop repetitive (C in most 3rd-job lists).
3rd job is not in the launch build and Nexon plans to rework it.
tips: Fighter at launch: toggle Final Attack off against single targets and bosses (meowdb: ~12% less Power Strike damage vs one mob) and on for 2-3 mob packs; it costs no MP, so leave it on when MP is your limit.
Refresh Rage and Booster together (both last 300 s at max), and don't spam Rush at low levels (40 MP at Lv 1); it reaches its full 150 dash distance at Lv 10.
Accuracy now scales strongly with level: being ~7+ levels under a mob is a wall, so level or use helmet/cape ACC before adding DEX (MetaRoad, Wild).
Crusader (COT2): keep Final Attack on - Wild's timing tests (FA ~600 ms animation that cuts the previous skill short by ~180 ms) show it builds orbs faster and raises both bossing and mobbing DPS.
Crusader (COT2): cash in Panic or Coma only at 5 orbs (x2.0 vs x1.6 at 4); mob with Rush, Slash Blast, then Coma, and boss with Power Strike plus FA procs, then Panic, leaving Rush out (Wild).
Crusader (COT2): close the gap with Rush before using Panic or Coma, and save Armor Crash (30 s cooldown at 20) for bosses.
classicChanges: Official launch scope (Founder's Access Oct 6, Grand Launch Oct 21): Maple Island and Victoria Island, 1st and 2nd job only, max level 100. 3rd job, Orbis and El Nath were COT2-only and are held back for rework (Founder's Access release notes; Aug 21 Ossyria Exploration Report).
Rush is now a Fighter (2nd job) skill and Power Guard moved from Fighter (COT1) to Crusader (COT2) (meowdb).
Official Aug 11 COT2 patch: Rush cooldown 3 s to 1 s and MP cost 30-10 to 40-20; also fixed Rush Lv 6 not moving the character.
Masteries lost their old Accuracy bonus: Sword Mastery now gives +90 WDEF and Axe Mastery a 25% bleed for 100% over 3 s (MetaRoad, meowdb).
Fighter Final Attack became a toggle that hits up to 3 mobs; COT2 raised the proc from 35% to 50% and cut damage from 180% to 140% (meowdb).
Rage buffs the new Attack Power stat; COT2 raised it from +35 to +40 with a -40 WDEF penalty (meowdb).

Crusader's COT2 book: Panic and Coma are single sword/axe skills that scale with orbs spent, Coma bleeds, Shout grants orbs and lowers Evasion, Armor Crash sets physical DEF to 0, and Power Guard joins the book.
Classic World-wide: level counts heavily in Warrior accuracy, monster DEF is a % reduction, everyone can crit, most area attacks cap at 4 targets, and the damage cap is 99,999 (MetaRoad).
builds.confidence: High for skill names, max levels and numbers: meowdb's COT2 tables and MetaRoad's planner (built from Skill.wz) agree on every Warrior skill, the only mismatches being Rush's MP cost and cooldown (the planner still has the pre-patch 30-10 MP and 3 s), which Nexon's Aug 11 note settles in meowdb's favour. High for the 1st-job order and Lv 30-70 endpoint (meowdb/Grummash benchmark); medium for the Lv 30-70 order (meowdb, Wild and MetaRoad disagree on Rage vs Final Attack vs Rush timing). 2nd-job SP stops at Lv 70 (121 SP), so the order ends with the axe set maxed and one spare point. Low-medium for 3rd job: a COT2 preview built from one tester guide (Wild) cross-checked against Thorn's Lv 100 and three Lv 120 builds; Nexon says 3rd job will be reworked. Comparisons to the original game are labelled pre-BB fallback.

weapons.why: Dragon Knight's attacks (Piercing Crusher, Dragon Fury, Dragon Roar) use the same 2.5x multiplier for spears and polearms, so Spear Mastery's +20% crit decides it; Redemption is also one speed stage faster than The Gold Dragon. All five public Lv 100-120 DK builds keep Spear Mastery 20 (Grummash, Usagi, Thorn, Kevn, Jacob).

Better for 2nd-job leveling: 3.5x swings land 60% of the time (~11% more Power Strike damage per minute at Lv 30, ~2% at 70), Polearm Mastery adds +20 Speed, and four polearms are craftable (no spears are). MetaRoad's Spearman guide favours it.

2nd-job SP stops at Lv 70, enough to max one full weapon family. A polearm (+20 Speed) for grinding plus a spear (+20% crit) for bosses either takes a Cash Shop SP Reset after 3rd job (Kevn's plan, Longinus) or, as in Jacob's no-reset build, skips Iron Will and most of Final Attack to fit both Masteries and Boosters.

builds.summary: At launch this branch is played as a Spearman to Lv 100: the longest-reaching Warrior, with a lifesteal Final Attack, Iron Will and the highest physical toughness of the 2H Warrior builds. Dragon Knight, its COT2-only 3rd job, was the consensus best Warrior of the test: Piercing Crusher shreds 1-3 targets, Dragon Fury hits four from long range, Dragon Roar clears eight, Dragon Blood adds +60 Attack Power and Hyper Body gives the party +30% Max HP, at the price of heavy HP and potion use.

mobbing.why: Launch: Slash Blast is the only AoE (4 mobs), but spears and polearms have the longest Warrior reach (~122 px basic attacks); 7,262 AoE DPS at Lv 70 (meowdb). COT2 preview: Dragon Fury (4 mobs at 225-241 px) and Dragon Roar (8 mobs) would lift this to 5.

bossing.why: Launch: 3,745 single-target DPS at Lv 70 - the lowest of the three Warriors but mid-pack overall - with +20% crit from Spear Mastery and a 260% lifesteal Final Attack. COT2 preview: Piercing Crusher (360-400% per cast) and Dragon Blood (+60 Attack Power) would lift it to about 4.

mobility.why: Launch: Rush (1 s cooldown) plus the longest reach; Polearm Mastery adds +20 Speed if you use polearms. meowdb rates all Warriors 3/5. COT2 preview: no new movement skill, but long-range Dragon Fury keeps it at about 3.

survival.why: Launch: the highest physical EHP of the realistic 2H Warrior builds (~4,330 at Lv 70), Iron Will (+50 WDEF, 35% knockback resist) and a Final Attack that heals 10% of its damage; no shield option. COT2 preview: Hyper Body (+30% HP) roughly offsets the new HP-cost skills, so about 4.

funding.why: Launch: #3 Damage/MP of the ten Lv 70 builds (224 per MP) and lifesteal saves HP potions; polearms are craftable but spears are not. COT2 preview: Dragon Roar (900-1,500 HP), Dragon Fury and Dragon Blood HP costs would drop it to about 3 - testers called potion use DK's main weakness.

party.why: Launch: no party buff or debuff before 3rd job - Iron Will is self-only (meowdb rates Spearman support lowest of the Warriors). COT2 preview: Hyper Body (+30% party Max HP) would make it a 5.

stats.rule: Raise DEX only to your next weapon's requirement (every Lv 30-70 spear or polearm needs DEX equal to its level; DEX on gear counts) and put every other AP into STR.

plan.do: No dice in Classic World: every stat starts at 4 and you place 9 AP at creation. Put all 9 into STR (13/4/4/4), then all 5 AP per level into STR (58 STR at Lv 10; meowdb's sample starts 12/5/4/4 and reaches 57 STR / 5 DEX). Beginner SP is 1 per level (9 by Lv 10): Three Snails, Recovery and Nimble Feet at 3 each. The Warrior advancement has no stat requirement.

Mostly STR (about 4 STR / 1 DEX per level), adding DEX only for weapon checkpoints: ~18 base DEX at Lv 20 and ~27 at Lv 30 so gear covers the Forked Spear / Mithril Pole Arm's 30 DEX (meowdb sample: 135 STR / 27 DEX at Lv 30).
+3 STR / +2 DEX for Lv 31-36, then +4 STR / +1 DEX until 60 base DEX (~Lv 57), then pure STR: ~302 STR / 60 DEX base at Lv 70, with ~10 DEX from gear for Redemption/The Gold Dragon.
All STR; total DEX stays at 70 (public Lv 100-120 DK builds sit at ~496-599 STR / 70 DEX).

weapons.why: Through Lv 30 every wand has 3 more M.ATK than the same-level staff with equal or lower LUK needs. The Lv 50/60/70 tiers (Cromi 83, Evil Tale 97, Angel Wings 111 M.ATK) are wands.

Fine when it's the higher-M.ATK option: Arc Staff (45), Thorns (55) and Evil Wings (65) fill the gaps and add +4-6% crit damage, but need about 5 more LUK. Cast speed ignores weapon speed, so a staff's slower speed costs nothing.
Wands and staves are one-handed. Pan Lid (Lv 10, 44 WDEF) has the best Guard chance for mages (8.09%). Esther Shield (Lv 35) trades Guard for 55 MDEF.

builds.summary: The mobbing mage: Thunder Bolt is the only 2nd-job attack that hits six monsters, and with Teleport and a big Magic Guard pool you can farm crowded platform maps in relative safety. Single-target damage is near the bottom of all 2nd jobs, so Cold Beam (now a slow, not a freeze) is for single mobs and ice-weak targets. Community guides and tier lists from both tests rate it the top leveling class.

mobbing.why: Launch: Thunder Bolt hits up to 6 mobs, the only 2nd-job attack that does while most AoE stops at 4. It gives the best mage EXP/min in MeowDB's Training Advisor (~19k at Lv 60, ~25k at Lv 70), and MetaRoad called I/L the strongest class to level in the betas. COT2 preview: Ice Strike (4 targets) and Thunder Spear (2) add damage, not reach.

bossing.why: Launch: even with Cold Beam, its best single-target spell, I/L ranks #9 of 10 second jobs at Lv 70 (~3,107 DPS on a neutral target), with no 2nd-job booster. COT2 preview: Thunder Spear, Element Amplification and Spell Booster would lift this to about 3.

mobility.why: Launch: Teleport (150 px, 15 MP at max), which MeowDB rates 5/5. It costs 55 MP per cast until you level it.

survival.why: Launch: tied-best magic EHP and A-grade physical EHP at Lv 70 thanks to Magic Guard and a big MP pool, though base HP stays low (+16 per level). COT2 preview: Elemental Resistance would add 20-40% vs elemental attacks.

funding.why: Launch: Thunder Bolt costs 40 MP a cast but clears whole packs. It has the best damage per MP of the three mages (114 vs 96/89), but MP Eater gets nothing from 0-MP Fire Boars. COT2 preview: Element Amplification raises MP costs by up to 50%.

party.why: Launch: Meditation (+25 Magic Attack) only helps other casters; six-target AoE suits full-party maps.

stats.creation: No dice rolls in Classic World. Stats start at 4 each with 9 points to place (25 total). Recommended: 4 STR / 4 DEX / 12 INT / 5 LUK (MeowDB); 4/4/13/4 is equivalent.
stats.rule: Put everything into INT (2 INT = 1 Magic Attack, and INT is a Magician's main accuracy stat). Raise base LUK only to equip your next weapon, since LUK adds no spell damage.

plan.do: No dice: 25 points. MeowDB's pick is 4 STR / 4 DEX / 12 INT / 5 LUK, where the extra LUK lines up with the 10/15/20 LUK wand requirements; 13/4 also works.
All 45 AP into INT (57 INT / 5 LUK at Lv 10). No stat requirement to become a Magician.

gear: Wand ladder (Classic data): Wooden 10 (27 M.ATK) -> Hardwood 15 (34) -> Metal 20 (41, 10 LUK) -> Ice 25 (48, 15 LUK) -> Mithril 30 (55, 20 LUK) -> Wizard Wand 35 (62) -> Fairy Wand 40 (69, 30 LUK) -> Arc Staff 45 (73, 40 LUK) -> Cromi 50 (83) -> Thorns 55 (87, staff) -> Evil Tale 60 (97) -> Evil Wings 65 (101, staff) -> Angel Wings 70 (111, 65 LUK).

COT players' Lv 40 power spike: a Fairy Wand with 7 Lesser Wand Magic Attack scrolls (100% success, +2 each; El Moth sells them for 25,000), plus a Blue Starlight/Blue Moonlight overall (+8 INT base in the COT2 item data; MetaRoad says +10).

Body armor: Blue Plain Robe 15 / Blue Doros Robe 25 / Blue Wizard Robe 30 (male overalls) or Yellow Arianne set 15 / Brown Doroness Robe 25 / Blue Fairy set 30 (female). Overalls have 10 slots for Overall INT scrolls (Kerning City citizenship shop); the female top/bottom sets can't use them.
Gloves: use Magic Attack scrolls, not Crit Rate (5 Lesser M.ATK ~ +3.1% damage vs ~+1.3% for crit on a Lv 70 build). W.ATK scrolls do nothing for spells.
Shield: Pan Lid (Green Mushroom drop) for the best Guard chance; Esther Shield at 35 if magic-hitting mobs are the problem.

Grummash's 'realistic' Lv 70 set (Angel Wings, Blue Infinium Circlet, Blue Requiem, Blue Lorin, Brown Lapiz Sandals, Blue Gaia Cape, Metal Silver Earrings, Esther Shield) is mostly Ossyria gear, so expect less at launch.
strengths: Thunder Bolt: the only 2nd-job attack that hits 6 mobs, and it can stun
Teleport plus safe platform maps (Lorang Lorang Lorang) make grinding low-risk
Tied-best Magic EHP at Lv 70; Magic Guard makes it far tankier than its HP suggests
Two elements cover more weaknesses: lightning-weak Lorang/Iron Hog/Echopus/Clang/Aqumander and ice-weak Fire Boar/Copper Drake/Duskmander
Meditation boosts every spell (+25 Magic Attack) for you and other mages
weaknesses: Second-lowest single-target damage of all 2nd jobs at Lv 70 (#9 of 10)
MP-hungry: 40 MP per Thunder Bolt; MP potions cost twice as much per point as HP potions
Cold Beam lost its freeze (slow only)
Elemental resists (8 Victoria mobs resist ice, e.g. Ligator, Drake, Croco) cut the matching spell by 25%
Its 3rd job (Ice Strike/Thunder Spear) isn't in the launch build
tips: Energy Bolt 20 out-hits Thunder Bolt on a single mob at any level, and out-hits Cold Beam until about Cold Beam 24 (18 against ice-weak mobs). Use Thunder Bolt only when it catches 2+ mobs, which is MeowDB's break-even.
Route used by COT players (MetaRoad): Ant Tunnel I until ~35-38, then Lorang Lorang Lorang (lightning-weak crabs, safe platforms) until ~50.
Swap spells by element: Cold Beam on Fire Boars in The Burnt Land; Thunder Bolt on Aqumander (resists ice, weak to lightning); Cold Beam on Myewood (resists lightning).
Don't spam Teleport at Lv 1 (55 MP). Save it for gaps and emergencies until it's leveled.
MP Eater fires at most once per 5 s and gets nothing from 0-MP mobs (Pig, Ribbon Pig, Wild Boar, Ligator, Fire Boar), so pack extra Lemons for Burnt Land.
Founder's Access has no Forgotten Hollow (official FA notes), so plan on Victoria Island maps for 40-60 at first.
classicChanges: Thunder Bolt keeps the 6-target cap while most Classic AoE dropped to 4, and gains a 25% electrocute (stun) chance. COT1 -> COT2: 45 -> 70 Basic Attack (MeowDB + OSMS datamines; MetaRoad).
Cold Beam: freeze replaced by a 3 s slow in COT2, and Basic Attack 120 -> 170 (OSMS COT1 data shows 'Frozen'; COT2 shows 'Slowed').
Slow: 4 -> 6 targets, 25 -> 20 s, plus -5 Evasion (COT2).
Energy Bolt / Magic Claw both buffed in COT2 (65 -> 130 and 30 -> 65 per hit), so the 1st-job attack choice is now about MP and terrain, not damage.
Magic Guard is a 15-level toggle; Magic Armor gives +120 WDEF and MDEF; Max MP Increase is +25%.
MP Eater stronger (50%/50%) but limited to once per 5 s; Meditation +25 for 300 s.

3rd job (COT2 only): Ice Strike 4 targets with a slow (no freeze), Thunder Spear 2 targets with stun, Element Composition shared with F/P, Elemental Resistance replaces Partial Resistance. Nexon says 3rd job will be reworked before release.

Magicians take 1st job at Lv 10 like every class, with no stat requirement, no Lv 8 head start and no bonus SP (official Founder's Access notes; MeowDB; MetaRoad). SP is 1 per level as a Beginner, then 3 per level plus 1 per advancement.

No dice: 25 stat points at creation (4 each plus 9 to place), then 5 AP per level. INT no longer adds MP (Magicians gain a flat +16 HP / +22 MP per level and +150 / +350 per advancement), 2 INT = 1 Magic Attack, and LUK adds no spell damage (MeowDB formulas; MetaRoad).

Magic can miss: spells roll a hit check based on level, INT and LUK. Elemental weakness and resistance are now +/-25% (pre-BB +/-50%), and Basic Attack values feed a new formula, so don't compare them one-for-one with pre-BB numbers.

Launch scope (official FA notes, Oct 3): Maple Island and Victoria Island, 1st and 2nd job only, max Lv 100; Forgotten Hollow not in Founder's Access. Orbis, El Nath and 3rd job were COT2-only and are held back for rework (Ossyria Exploration Report, Aug 21). COT2 had no Lv 70 cap (3rd job at 70, free Lv 100 boost from Aug 11); COT1 capped at 50.

Magicians take 1st job at Lv 10 like every class, with no stat requirement, no Lv 8 head start and no bonus SP (official Founder's Access notes; MeowDB; MetaRoad). SP is 1 per level as a Beginner, then 3 per level plus 1 per advancement.

Magic can miss: spells roll a hit check based on level, INT and LUK. Elemental weakness and resistance are now +/-25% (pre-BB +/-50%), and Basic Attack values feed a new formula, so don't compare them one-for-one with pre-BB numbers.

Launch scope (official FA notes, Oct 3): Maple Island and Victoria Island, 1st and 2nd job only, max Lv 100; Forgotten Hollow not in Founder's Access. Orbis, El Nath and 3rd job were COT2-only and are held back for rework (Ossyria Exploration Report, Aug 21). COT2 had no Lv 70 cap (3rd job at 70, free Lv 100 boost from Aug 11); COT1 capped at 50.

Training route: Transfer Area Stirges at 30 with Energy Bolt, Jr. Wraiths (Line 1/2 subway, holy-weak) from ~41, Ant Tunnel II/III mushrooms at 50-60, Wraiths and Ant Tunnel Park near 70.
Spread Holy Arrow when one arrow kills a mob (e.g. Ant Tunnel mushrooms at 50+); focus all three on tougher mobs. At 50, Jr. Wraiths die to two arrows, so the third is wasted.
In a party, keep Bless up (300 s at max). Physical classes lost the old mastery accuracy and now miss mobs above their level, so +16-20 ACC is very noticeable.
Use Heal instead of HP potions (Heal 2 ~ 110 HP for 12 MP). Save the White/Red potions for emergencies.
classicChanges: Holy Arrow: 1 target -> 3 arrows (focus or split). COT2 raised each arrow from 40 to 60 Basic Attack (MeowDB + OSMS; MetaRoad).
Heal: max recovery 300% -> 100%, undead damage sharply reduced, 6 shared target slots. Clerics can no longer level by Heal-spamming undead (MeowDB, MetaRoad, xBucc).
Bless: dropped the Weapon/Magic DEF bonus and now adds +10% Heal recovery (COT1 boosted all item/skill healing).
Invincible: now also damages mobs that touch you (30 Basic Attack at max).

Priest (COT2 only): Holy Symbol is a self-only resurrection with a 45-min cooldown instead of the +50% party EXP buff; Shining Ray hits 4; Doom needs no Magic Rock but has a 30 s cooldown; Summon Dragon lasts 300 s. Nexon says 3rd job will be reworked before release.

Magicians take 1st job at Lv 10 like every class, with no stat requirement, no Lv 8 head start and no bonus SP (official Founder's Access notes; MeowDB; MetaRoad). SP is 1 per level as a Beginner, then 3 per level plus 1 per advancement.

No dice: 25 stat points at creation (4 each plus 9 to place), then 5 AP per level. INT no longer adds MP (Magicians gain a flat +16 HP / +22 MP per level and +150 / +350 per advancement), 2 INT = 1 Magic Attack, and LUK adds no spell damage (MeowDB formulas; MetaRoad).

Magic can miss: spells roll a hit check based on level, INT and LUK. Elemental weakness and resistance are now +/-25% (pre-BB +/-50%), and Basic Attack values feed a new formula, so don't compare them one-for-one with pre-BB numbers.

Launch scope (official FA notes, Oct 3): Maple Island and Victoria Island, 1st and 2nd job only, max Lv 100; Forgotten Hollow not in Founder's Access. Orbis, El Nath and 3rd job were COT2-only and are held back for rework (Ossyria Exploration Report, Aug 21). COT2 had no Lv 70 cap (3rd job at 70, free Lv 100 boost from Aug 11); COT1 capped at 50.

weapons.why: Every Hunter skill (Bow Mastery, Bow Booster, Soul Arrow, Final Attack, Arrow Bomb) works only with a bow, and bows cycle faster than crossbows (most are Normal speed; the Lv 25 Battle Bow is Fast). Lv 70 Golden Hinkel: 88 W.ATK plus 2% crit rate.

Usable before Lv 30 (except at Lv 20, early crossbows carry 2-5 more W.ATK than same-level bows and need less STR), but Hunter skills stop working with one; axtonyew's community guide swaps to the Battle Bow at Lv 25.

builds.summary: The bow branch. At launch you play it as a Hunter all the way to the Lv 100 cap: the longest range in the game, Arrow Bomb blowing up four-mob groups (the #2 area damage of the ten 2nd jobs at Lv 70), and Soul Arrow ending arrow costs. Ranger exists only as a COT2 preview: Arrow Rain, a point-blank volley that hits four mobs twice, Strafe for single targets, and Wind Step as the Bowman's first dash. The costs are the lowest effective HP of the 2nd jobs (tied with Crossbowman), constant spacing to avoid bow-whacking, heavy MP use, and no movement skill at launch.

mobbing.why: Launch: Hunter's Arrow Bomb (140% to 4 mobs, 60% stun) was the #2 AoE of the ten 2nd jobs at Lv 70 (meowdb benchmark). COT2 preview: Arrow Rain hits 4 mobs twice around you with no minimum range and, since Aug 11, no cooldown.

bossing.why: Launch: Hunter placed #4 of 10 in Lv 70 single-target DPS (Double Shot/Arrow Blow plus Final Attack) with no party buff; the launch bosses are Mano, Mushmom, Shade, Zombie Mushmom and Jr. Balrog. COT2 preview: Strafe (4 x 100%) is Ranger's only single-target skill.

mobility.why: Launch: no movement skill at all (meowdb mobility 1/5, tied last), every attack except Power Knockback is ground-only, and Bowmen have no Haste. COT2 preview: Wind Step adds a 1 s-cooldown forward hop (304-410 distance) that would lift this to about 3.

survival.why: +22 HP per level and Lv 70 physical/magic EHP tied for last among 2nd jobs; offsets are 420-470 px range, +20 Evasion from Bow Mastery, Arrow Bomb stuns and Amazon's Judgement slows (plus Silver Hawk stuns in the COT2 preview).

funding.why: Plain arrows cost 1 meso and Soul Arrow (from about Lv 34) stops arrow use; bows through Lv 50 are shop or Woodcrafting items. The real bill is MP potions (Arrow Bomb 28 MP) and Woodcrafting for the Lv 35-50 bows and Iron/Adamantium arrows.

party.why: No party buffs in 1st or 2nd job (meowdb Support 2.5/5 for Hunter); brings damage and Arrow Bomb stuns. The COT2 Ranger book adds no party buff either.

stats.creation: No dice in Classic World: every stat starts at 4 and you place 9 AP yourself on the creation screen (25 total). Put them in DEX, i.e. 4 STR / 13 DEX / 4 INT / 4 LUK (meowdb's sample uses 5 STR / 12 DEX).
stats.rule: Keep base STR equal to your level (bows need STR = weapon level from Lv 15); every other point goes into DEX.

plan.do: All AP into DEX. meowdb says Classic removed the 1st-job stat check (mapleclassic.wiki and henesys.gg still list 25 DEX); the Lv 10 War Bow and Crossbow need 25 DEX either way.
Bring STR to 15 for the Composite Bow (15 STR / 35 DEX); the rest into DEX (meowdb: +10 STR, +15 DEX).
+1 STR / +4 DEX per level: 20 STR for Hunter's Bow, 25 for Battle Bow, 30 for Ryden. That is about 30 STR / 132 base DEX at Lv 30.
Keep +1 STR / +4 DEX, reaching 70 STR / about 292 base DEX at Lv 70, exactly the Golden Hinkel's 70 STR requirement.

The Lv 70 Hinkels (70 STR) are the highest bows in meowdb's COT2 item data, so 70 base STR covers every known bow. Either keep +1 STR / +4 DEX so you are ready for higher bows when Ossyria and 3rd job return, or go all DEX. No source covers AP past 70, so this step is inferred.

variants.name: STR buffer (axtonyew, community guide)
variants.how: Hold base STR at level + 5 instead of exactly your level.
variants.tradeoff: Lets you equip higher-requirement drops right away, but costs about 5 DEX of damage and accuracy.

variants.name: Gear-covered STR
variants.how: Leave base STR a few points short and cover the gap with STR on other equipment (gear can meet a requirement; the weapon's own stats cannot).
variants.tradeoff: A few extra DEX, but swapping that gear can leave you unable to equip your bow.

variants.name: Crossbow first
variants.how: Use crossbows (more W.ATK, lower STR) before 2nd job, then switch to the Battle Bow at Lv 25.
variants.tradeoff: Better early damage, but you still need 25 STR by Lv 25 for the bow.

variants.name: Pure DEX after Lv 70 (launch)
variants.how: Stop adding STR once you hold 70 base STR, since no bow above Lv 70 is in the COT2 data.
variants.tradeoff: Up to 30 extra DEX by Lv 100, but you will need an AP reset or catch-up STR if higher bows arrive with 3rd job.

Hawk with 100 attack power for 300 s and a 100% chance to stun for 1.5 s; damage scales with DEX/STR, not weapon attack, and it can miss; 65 MP and 1 Summoning Rock; needs Puppet 5.
Rapid single-target volley: 3 hits up to level 15, then 4 hits, ending at 4 x 100% for 32 MP.

gear: Bows through Lv 30 come from Karl in Henesys: War Bow (10), Composite Bow (15), Hunter's Bow (20), Battle Bow (25, Fast), Ryden (30, 26,000 mesos).

No shop sells the Lv 35-50 bows: Red Viper (Lv 35, 52 W.ATK, Fast) is a Woodcrafting 7 recipe, Vaulter 2000 (40) is Woodcrafting 8 and Olympus (50) is Woodcrafting 10. Start Woodcrafting with Vicious in Henesys around Lv 25; COT1 players farmed Monkey Forest once they had a scrolled Red Viper (MetaRoad).

Lv 60-70 bows are drops: Asianic Bow (60), then the Lv 70 Hinkels (Golden 88 W.ATK + 2% crit, Red 90, Blue 88). They are the top bows in meowdb's COT2 data, so they carry you to the Lv 100 launch cap.

Arrows: plain ones are 1 meso at any grocer; Bronze (+1 W.ATK) cost 2 mesos from Raymond once you reach Helpful Stranger in Henesys citizenship (Lv 22 + 2,000 contribution); Iron (+2) and Adamantium (+3) are craft-only (Woodcrafting 7 / 10).
Scroll gloves for Attack, not Critical Rate: five Lesser Attack scrolls added about 9.8% expected damage at Lv 30 vs 1.6% for crit (meowdb), and Attack still wins at Lv 70.

Bowmen can wear a Sauna Robe at Lv 30 (Blue for male characters, Red for female; +1 all stats, 10 slots); Overall DEX scrolls from Henesys citizenship turn it into a damage piece. Kiwi's COT2 plan puts spare mesos into the bow and 60% (Intermediate) bow attack scrolls from Lv 40.

Grummash's Lv 70 benchmark kit: Golden Hinkel, Green Patriot, Beige Linnex, Blue Eyes, Green Elf Shoes, White Gaia Cape, Metal Silver Earrings and Adamantium arrows (72 STR / 338 DEX / 103 W.ATK / 155 ACC / 31% crit).
strengths: Longest reach in the game: 420 px shots and 470 px Arrow Blow with max Eye of Amazon (tied #1 range with Crossbowman).
Hunter was the #2 AoE damage dealer of the ten 2nd jobs at Lv 70 (Arrow Bomb: 4 targets plus a 60% stun) and #4 for single-target.
Bowmen have the best accuracy in the game (DEX and level both feed it), so misses are rare.
Soul Arrow removes arrow costs, and bows attack faster than crossbows (the Red Viper and Battle Bow are Fast).
COT2 preview: Arrow Rain hits twice point-blank with no cooldown, and Wind Step is the first dash a Bowman gets.
weaknesses: Lowest effective HP of the 2nd jobs (+22 HP per level and no shield or Magic Guard; Lv 70 physical and magic EHP tied last with Crossbowman); meowdb calls Hunter probably the squishiest class.
Inside 65 px the bow whacks for roughly a third of a melee hit, and Power Knockback is the only attack usable mid-air.
No movement skill at launch: you walk and jump everywhere until 3rd job returns.
MP hungry: Arrow Bomb costs 28 MP a cast, so dense maps burn through Lemons.
COT2 testers outside North America reported delayed Arrow Bomb explosions; meowdb suspects high ping, but that is unconfirmed.
Ranger itself is not in the launch build, and Nexon says 3rd job will be reworked before it arrives.
tips: Keep at least 65 px between you and mobs; closer than that your bow whacks. Power Knockback (usable mid-jump) is your reset button.

Become a Henesys citizen at Lv 12 (Arthur, Henesys Town Hall) so contribution builds: Raymond's Bronze Arrows (2 mesos) unlock at Helpful Stranger (Lv 22, 2,000 contribution), Overall DEX scrolls at Distinguished Citizen and Glove Attack scrolls at Guardian of the Village. Raymond's Supreme Sniper Potions (+7 ACC) need no grade.
Final Attack: Bow is a toggle: leave it on for single targets (about +8% DPS with Double Shot, and it costs no MP), but turn it off when Arrow Bomb is hitting 3-4 mobs (about -9% / -14% DPS).
Start Woodcrafting by Lv 25; the Red Viper, Vaulter 2000, Olympus and the +2/+3 arrows only come from crafting or other players.
Test a few Arrow Bomb pulls before settling on a map: the explosion needs grouped mobs, and some testers outside North America saw it lag.
COT2 preview: once 3rd job returns, Arrow Rain works in the middle of a pack and Wind Step hops platforms, but each hop costs 65 MP until you level it.
classicChanges: Official (Aug 11, 2026 COT2 patch): Arrow Rain's 5 s cooldown removed; Wind Step cooldown cut from 3 s to 1 s and its MP cost raised from 35-15 to 65-25 (level 1-20).
Official (Aug 11, 2026): invincibility after taking a hit raised from 1 s to 1.5 s for all jobs.
Official (Aug 7, 2026): fixed ranged attacks sometimes knocking monsters toward you instead of away.

Official (Aug 21 Ossyria Exploration Report; Oct 3 Founder's Access notes): Orbis, El Nath and 3rd Job Advancement are held back from Founder's Access and Grand Launch for rework; launch is 1st and 2nd job on Maple Island and Victoria Island with a Lv 100 cap.
Datamined (meowdb/MetaRoad): most AoE is capped at 4 targets. Arrow Bomb went from 150% on 6 mobs to 140% on 4; Arrow Rain hits 4 mobs twice.
Datamined: Power Knockback moved from 2nd to 1st job (15 levels, 4 targets, always crits); Amazon's Judgement moved from 1st to 2nd job and now slows on crits.
Datamined: Bow Mastery gives +20 Evasion instead of Accuracy; Final Attack: Bow became a toggle (COT1 35% / 100%, COT2 50% / 3 x 90%).

Datamined: Eye of Amazon and Critical Shot are 15-level skills; every job can crit (5% base, crits add +20% damage instead of the original's 200% crits), and max Critical Shot adds +20% crit rate and +15% crit damage.
Datamined: Wind Step is new, and the COT2 Ranger book has no Thrust (the original's speed passive; pre-BB fallback, not confirmed for Classic World).
Bow-whacking inside 65 px stayed: the early playtest wording that let ranged jobs shoot point-blank was dropped by the CBT data (MetaRoad, official-forum tester).
builds.confidence: Confirmed (official): launch has 1st and 2nd job only, on Maple Island and Victoria Island, with a Lv 100 cap; 3rd job, Orbis and El Nath were COT2-only and are held back for rework; job levels and the Aug 11 Arrow Rain/Wind Step changes. Inferred: the Ranger SP order is my synthesis because no COT2 source publishes one, and Ranger may change in the rework; AP past Lv 70 has no source. weapons.why: Every Crossbowman skill (Mastery, Booster, Soul Arrow, Final Attack) needs a crossbow. Crossbows hit harder per shot (Lv 70 Gross Jaeger 92 W.ATK vs Golden Hinkel 88) and need 10 less STR than bows, but most are Slow speed.
Usable before Lv 30 (the Lv 25 Battle Bow is the fastest early weapon), but bows need STR equal to their level and Crossbowman skills stop working with one.

builds.summary: The crossbow branch. At launch you play it as a Crossbowman to the Lv 100 cap: slower shots that hit harder, a 20% chance per attack to ignore defense, and Iron Arrow piercing a lined-up row of four mobs. Sniper exists only as a COT2 preview: Arrow Eruption for point-blank four-target clears, Strafe for single targets, and Evasion Step to hop backward and keep shooting. It trails the bow line in attack speed and in meowdb's Lv 70 DPS benchmarks, but is cheaper on STR and a little better on damage per MP.

mobbing.why: Launch: Iron Arrow pierces 4 mobs (180%, losing 20% per mob) and Crossbowman ranked #6 of 10 for Lv 70 AoE, still inside meowdb's top grade band; it needs flat lanes. COT2 preview: Arrow Eruption hits 4 mobs for 250% around you with no minimum range or cooldown.

bossing.why: Launch: #7 of 10 in Lv 70 single-target DPS, helped by higher-W.ATK crossbows, Crossbow Mastery's 20% defense-ignore and a 250% Final Attack proc; launch bosses are Mano, Mushmom, Shade, Zombie Mushmom and Jr. Balrog. COT2 preview: the same Strafe as Ranger, at crossbow speed.

mobility.why: Launch: no movement skill (meowdb mobility 1/5, tied last), every attack except Power Knockback is ground-only, and Bowmen have no Haste. COT2 preview: Evasion Step only hops backward, so it would lift this to about 2.

survival.why: Same +22 HP per level and last-place Lv 70 EHP as Hunter, without Bow Mastery's +20 Evasion; range is the main defence (plus Blizzard slows and Golden Eagle stuns in the COT2 preview).

funding.why: 1-meso arrows, Soul Arrow from about Lv 34, and crossbows need 10 less STR than bows (more DEX for free); Iron/Mithril arrows and several crossbows are craft or drop only, and MP potions (Iron Arrow 28 MP) are the main bill.

party.why: No party buffs in 1st/2nd job, and control is limited to Amazon's Judgement crit slows and Power Knockback (meowdb Support 1.5/5, tied last); the COT2 Sniper book only adds a slow, a stun summon and a decoy.

stats.creation: No dice in Classic World: every stat starts at 4 and you place 9 AP yourself on the creation screen (25 total). Put them in DEX, i.e. 4 STR / 13 DEX / 4 INT / 4 LUK (meowdb's sample uses 5 STR / 12 DEX).
stats.rule: From Lv 20, keep base STR at your level minus 10 (the crossbow requirement); every other point goes into DEX.

plan.do: All AP into DEX. meowdb says Classic removed the 1st-job stat check (mapleclassic.wiki and henesys.gg still list 25 DEX); the Lv 10 Crossbow needs 25 DEX either way.
Pure DEX; the Lv 15 Battle Crossbow needs 35 DEX and no STR.
Add 5 STR per 5 levels: 10 STR at Lv 20 (Balanche), 15 at 25 (Mountain Crossbow), 20 at 30 (Eagle Crow). That is about 20 STR / 142 base DEX at Lv 30.
+1 STR / +4 DEX per level, reaching 60 STR / about 302 base DEX at Lv 70, exactly the Gross Jaeger's 60 STR.

The Lv 70 Gross Jaeger (60 STR) is the highest crossbow in meowdb's COT2 item data, so 60 base STR covers every known crossbow. Either keep +1 STR / +4 DEX so you are ready for higher crossbows when Ossyria and 3rd job return, or go all DEX. No source covers AP past 70, so this step is inferred.

variants.name: STR = level (axtonyew, community guide)
variants.how: From Lv 30 keep STR equal to your level, 10 more than crossbows need.
variants.tradeoff: Lets you borrow on-level bows, but spends 10 AP that meowdb's item data says a crossbow never uses.

variants.name: Gear-covered STR
variants.how: Leave base STR a few points short and cover the gap with STR on other equipment (gear can meet a requirement; the weapon's own stats cannot).
variants.tradeoff: A few extra DEX, but swapping that gear can leave you unable to equip your crossbow.

variants.name: Bow before 2nd job
variants.how: Use the Fast Battle Bow at Lv 25, then return to crossbows at Lv 30.
variants.tradeoff: Faster early attacks, but bows need STR equal to their level, which a Crossbowman never needs again.

variants.name: Pure DEX after Lv 70 (launch)
variants.how: Stop adding STR once you hold 60 base STR, since no crossbow above Lv 70 is in the COT2 data.
variants.tradeoff: Up to 30 extra DEX by Lv 100, but you will need an AP reset or catch-up STR if higher crossbows arrive with 3rd job.

weapons.why: Lucky Seven, Drain, Avenger, Shadow Partner, Claw Mastery, Claw Booster and Claw Guard all need a claw. The claw's W.ATK adds to the throwing star's W.ATK.

Every star skill uses them: 2 per Lucky Seven and 4 per Avenger, doubled while Shadow Partner is up. Star W.ATK stacks on the claw: Subi +15, Wolbi +17, Mokbi +19, Kumbi +21, Tobi +23, Steely +25, Ilbi +27, Hwabi +29.
Any Thief can equip one, but nothing in the Assassin or Hermit kit scales with it. It only makes sense on the Double Stab (Bandit) route.

builds.summary: A ranged star-thrower. You level with Lucky Seven from 400 px away, pick up party Haste and big critical hits as an Assassin, and in the COT2 preview add Shadow Partner, a 4-target piercing Avenger and Flash Jump with no cooldown. Lucky Seven stays your single-target button for the whole game and Avenger clears small packs. The price is fragile HP and constant spending on stars, scrolls and Summoning Rocks.

mobbing.why: Launch: Assassin has no multi-target attack at all (meowdb's Lv 70 AoE DPS: N/A), so you clear maps by one- or two-shotting weaker mobs with Lucky Seven from 400 px. COT2's Hermit would add Avenger (150% on up to 4 targets).

bossing.why: Launch: Lucky Seven is the #3 single-target attack of the ten Lv 70 2nd jobs (4,266 DPS, about 256k per minute) and the more MP-efficient of the two thieves' main attacks (about 160 damage per MP, #6 of 10 in meowdb's tier table). It hits from 400 px, so you can stay out of melee reach. COT2's Shadow Partner would add +40% to every star.

mobility.why: Launch: party Haste (+30 Speed, +10 Jump), Dark Sight and mid-jump attacks give Assassin a 4.0 mobility score in meowdb's table, behind only the Teleport mages. COT2's Hermit would add Flash Jump with no cooldown.

survival.why: Launch: thin HP (+22 per level) and B-grade physical EHP (about 3,850 at Lv 70), offset by S-grade range (4.5/5, just behind the bowmen), Critical Recovery (10% HP/MP on a crit every 30 s) and Dark Sight. COT2's Claw Guard and Meso Saver would add a block chance and a one-time death save.

funding.why: Launch: every Lucky Seven throws 2 stars, and better stars cost a lot to buy before cheap recharges (Hwabi recharges run about 2,700 mesos an hour). Max Claw Mastery saves about 25% of stars, but claws, scrolls and stars are expected to be pricey. COT2's Shadow Partner would double star use and add Summoning Rock costs.

party.why: Launch: Haste is the only party tool (meowdb support 3.0, mid-pack), and all damage is single-target.

stats.creation: No dice roll. Every stat starts at 4 and you place 9 free AP on the creation screen. Put all 9 into LUK (4/4/4/13); meowdb's sample uses 4/5/4/12, and either is fine.
stats.rule: Put everything into LUK. Add DEX only when your next claw needs it, which works out to about 1 DEX per level after Lv 30 and stops at 70 total DEX.

plan.do: All 5 AP per level into LUK, for about 57 base LUK at Lv 10. meowdb says Classic removed the stat check for 1st job. Two other sites still list 25 DEX, so look at Dark Lord's requirement before you skip DEX completely.

Add DEX only for each claw: 15 DEX by Lv 15 (Steel Titans), 20 by Lv 20 (Steel Igor), 25 by Lv 25 (Meba), 30 by Lv 30 (Adamantium Guards). Everything else goes into LUK, giving 4 STR / 30 DEX / 4 INT / 132 LUK base at Lv 30.

Add 1 DEX and 4 LUK every level, reaching 4/70/4/292 base at Lv 70. Black Scarab needs 70 DEX and 145 LUK; Lv 70 thief armor needs 60 DEX and 130 LUK. Count DEX from equipped gear before you add base DEX.
All AP into LUK. Claw DEX requirements stop at 70, and a +3 DEX item such as Blue Mystique Shoes lets you hold base DEX at 67.

variants.name: Low-DEX ("dexless") Assassin
variants.how: Keep base DEX near 25 (or lower) and get the claw's DEX from DEX-scrolled overalls, capes and shoes. The most-upvoted community Assassin build on meowdb has 25 base DEX and 237 LUK at Lv 50.
variants.tradeoff: More LUK means more damage, but the gear is expensive. Accuracy and claw requirements both read total DEX, so swapping gear can unequip your claw and lower your hit rate. meowdb's advice: trim DEX to the weapon requirement, don't zero it.

variants.name: Female Thief
variants.how: Make the character female so you can wear Dark Avenger, a Lv 35 overall with +6 LUK and 10 slots (+16 LUK after Lesser scrolls).
variants.tradeoff: About 5 more LUK than a scrolled male Blue Sauna Robe. The choice is locked at creation.

variants.name: Alternative 2nd-job orders
variants.how: metaroad (Piu) raises Critical Throw before finishing Claw Mastery and leaves Haste for last. Grummash's Lv 70 sample maxes Drain and holds Critical Recovery at 12 and Claw Booster at 9.
variants.tradeoff: Haste-last means slow early movement. Drain-max gives a stronger emergency heal, but Drain does about half of Lucky Seven's damage per MP.

variants.name: COT2 3rd job: Avenger before Shadow Partner
variants.how: After Avenger 5 and Flash Jump 1, max Avenger before Shadow Partner.
variants.tradeoff: Faster pack clearing from Lv 70 to 85 (Avenger goes from about 98% to 150%), but weaker single-target until Shadow Partner catches up. This is my inference; no published COT2 guide covers it.

order.note: Lv 10. Start throwing stars right away.
Lv 11. Unlocks Keen Eyes.
Lv 12. +50 px range straight away.
Lv 12–18. Max your attack: 2 stars at 140%.
Lv 18–23. 400 px total range.
Lv 23–27. +15 Accuracy / +15 Avoid.
Lv 27–28. Unlocks Dark Sight.
Lv 28–30. Travel utility (43 MP, −13 Speed while hidden).

skip.why: Dagger-only attack. The claw build never uses it.
No 1st-job SP left. Max Dark Sight would only remove its speed penalty and cut its cost to 30 MP.

order.note: Lv 30. Immediate +10 Speed / +1 Jump.
Lv 31–32. Unlocks Claw Booster.
Lv 32. Level 1 already gives the full +2 speed stages (100 s).
Lv 33–37. +20 Attack Power and 25% star retrieval. Lucky Seven ignores Claw Mastery's mastery, but the Attack Power still raises its damage.
Lv 38–47. +15% crit rate / +35% crit damage.
Lv 48–54. +30 Speed / +10 Jump for 300 s.
Lv 54–56. 180 s per cast.
Lv 57–63. 10% HP and MP back on a crit, once every 30 s.
Lv 63–67. 300 s, same timer as Haste.
Lv 67–70. Drain stops at 11 when 2nd-job SP runs out at Lv 70, the end of meowdb's default build.

skip.why: Where 2nd-job SP runs out at Lv 70; Lucky Seven does the work and Drain is an emergency heal.

skills.note: 2nd-job SP stops at Lv 70 (121 SP), so every Assassin skill ends maxed except Drain at 11/30.

order.note: Lv 70. Your only 3rd-job point: a 4-target piercing star. My inference: Shadow Partner at Lv 1 adds just +10% and costs a Summoning Rock.
Lv 71–72. Unlocks Flash Jump.
Lv 72. The double jump works at Lv 1 (70 MP per jump, no cooldown).
Lv 72–82. The shadow adds 40% to every star attack for 300 s. Star use doubles.
Lv 82–90. 150% on up to 4 targets.
Lv 91–97. Cost drops to 30 MP and distance rises from 304 to 410 px. Raise it earlier if Flash Jump's MP cost is starving you.
Lv 97–100. W.DEF plus a block chance (needs a claw).
Lv 100. One point already gives a survive-one-fatal-hit buff. Matches the only Lv 100 COT2 Hermit build found (Shadow Partner 30 / Avenger 30 / Flash Jump 20 / Claw Guard 10 / Meso Saver 1).

skip.why: A 5 s snare on 4 targets for 45% total damage. Lv 120 COT2 builds dump leftover SP here or into Shadow Meso.
Needs Meso Saver 5 and spends 500 mesos per throw (1,000 with Shadow Partner up). Most Lv 120 builds leave it at 11–17.

skills.note: No published COT2 guide gives a 3rd-job order. This one is inferred from 7 COT2 Lv 100–120 builds on meowdb, all of which max Shadow Partner, Avenger and Flash Jump first. Nexon says 3rd job will be reworked before release.

skillInfo.classicChange: Max level cut to 15. The 2008 version went to 20 (+20/+20).

skillInfo.classicChange: Spread over 15 levels instead of 8 (same +200 at max). COT1's max was +150; COT2 raised it to +200.

skillInfo.what: Dagger only: two stabs at 160% each for 16 MP (Lv 20).
skillInfo.classicChange: 160% x2, up from 140% x2 in the 2008 list. Early previews showed 175%.

skillInfo.classicChange: COT1 was 120%, raised to 140% in COT2 (2008: 150% x2). Damage now runs through Classic's new formula.

skillInfo.what: Mastery level 10, +20 Attack Power and a 25% chance to get thrown stars back (Lv 20).
skillInfo.classicChange: Attack Power and star recovery replace the old +20 Accuracy and larger star stacks.

skillInfo.what: +15% crit rate and +35% crit damage at Lv 30, on top of everyone's base 5% / +20%. Needs Claw Mastery 3.
skillInfo.classicChange: Every class can crit in Classic. In 2008 this skill was the crit source itself: 50% chance for 200% damage.

skillInfo.what: +2 attack-speed stages at every level. Lv 20 lasts 300 s for 10 HP / 10 MP. Needs Claw Mastery 5.
skillInfo.classicChange: Max duration is now 300 s (2008: 200 s).

skillInfo.what: On a critical hit, recover 10% HP and 10% MP (100% chance at Lv 20), then a 30 s lockout.
skillInfo.classicChange: New Classic skill. The old Endure regen passive is gone.

skillInfo.what: 240% star hit (28 MP) with a 12% chance to absorb 15% of the damage as HP, capped at 25% of max HP. Needs Critical Recovery 3.
skillInfo.classicChange: COT1 absorbed on every hit; COT2 made it a 12% proc. 2008: 160% with 45% absorb, and it needed Endure 3.

skillInfo.what: Party buff: +30 Speed and +10 Jump for 300 s (35 MP). The area grows at Lv 11. Doesn't stack with a Bandit's Haste.
skillInfo.classicChange: Weaker but longer than in 2008 (+40 Speed / +20 Jump for 200 s).

skillInfo.what: With a claw equipped: +60 W.DEF and a 5% chance to fully block a physical attack (Lv 20).
skillInfo.classicChange: New Classic skill. Alchemist was removed.

skillInfo.what: Costs a Magic Stone plus mesos. While active it saves you from one fatal hit and heals 25% HP. Lasts 30 min at Lv 20, with a 45 min cooldown per meowdb. Needs Claw Guard 5.
skillInfo.classicChange: New Classic skill. Meso Up was removed.

skillInfo.what: Throws 500 mesos for 8x damage (about 4,000 base) and ignores weapon-defense-up and magic-guard-up buffs. DEX gives a chance to refund half the cost. Needs Meso Saver 5.

skillInfo.what: A giant star that pierces up to 4 targets for 150% (45 MP, 4 stars). Usable mid-jump.
skillInfo.classicChange: Capped at 4 targets and 150%. The 2008 max was 6 targets at 180%.

skillInfo.what: A second jump in mid-air. Costs 70 MP at Lv 1 and 30 MP at Lv 20; distance grows from 304 to 410 px. No cooldown. Needs Avenger 5.

skillInfo.what: Snares up to 4 enemies for 5 s and deals 45% total damage (15 MP at max).
skillInfo.classicChange: Now deals damage but holds 4 targets. In 2008 it held up to 6 for 8 s.

gear: Claws: Beginner's Garnier (Lv 10) → Steel Titans (15) → Steel Igor (20) → Meba (25, Faster speed; within 1–3% of Adamantium Guards' DPS) → Adamantium Guards (30, 23 W.ATK) → Dark Guardian (35, Weaponcrafting 7) → Dark Slain (50, Weaponcrafting 10; the Dark version gives +1% crit) → Dark Gigantic (60) → Black Scarab (70, 47 W.ATK, needs 70 DEX / 145 LUK).

Stars: start on Subi from Dr. Faymus. Wolbi costs 1,000 mesos per 500 from Max once you reach Kerning City's Helpful Stranger citizenship grade. Recharging runs 0.3–1.0 mesos per star (Hwabi is about 2,700 mesos an hour); the expensive part is buying the first sets. Carry several stacks, and don't main Snowball, Wooden Top or Icicle (1 meso per star to recharge).

Scrolls: put W.ATK on the claw and gloves, not crit (5 Lesser glove attack scrolls ≈ +6.5% damage, vs +2.6% for crit). Put LUK on cape, overall and earrings. Scroll tiers: Lesser 100% (+1), Intermediate 60% (+2), Greater 10% (+3), Chaos 10% (+4, 50% chance to destroy the item).
Overall: female thieves get Dark Avenger at Lv 35 (+6 LUK, 10 slots, +16 LUK with Lessers). Males use a scrolled Blue Sauna Robe (+11 LUK) or a separate top and bottom.

Lv 70 set used in the COT2 benchmark builds: Black Scarab, White Nightfox, Dark Studded Top and Pants, Gold Rover gloves, Blue Mystique Shoes (+3 DEX), Black Gaia Cape, Metal Silver Earrings, Tobi stars (Grummash's realistic build).
Hermit upkeep (COT2 preview): Summoning Rocks for Shadow Partner, Magic Stones plus mesos for Meso Saver, mesos for Shadow Meso.
strengths: Longest thief reach: 400 px stars with max Keen Eyes, and every attack works mid-jump.
Simple, strong single-target damage: Lucky Seven is #3 among Lv 70 2nd jobs and the top ranged attack, and with Shadow Partner it stays the best Hermit attack.
Excellent mobility: Haste, and in the preview Flash Jump with no cooldown.
Self-sustain: Critical Recovery, star retrieval from Claw Mastery, and the preview's Meso Saver.
Community favorite: Hermit was the most-picked 3rd job in COT2 (Nexon's Ossyria report), so parties and guides will be easy to find.
weaknesses: No AoE at all as an Assassin, which is the launch class. Avenger (preview) only hits 4 targets.
Expensive: stars, Summoning Rocks, and claws and scrolls that everyone wants.
Low HP and defense. The claw punches instead of throwing inside 65 px.
Accuracy matters: a miss still spends 2 stars and 16 MP.
Hermit itself is not in the Oct 21 launch, and Nexon is reworking 3rd job.
tips: Level 10–40 on Lucky Seven with max Keen Eyes. Stirges in Kerning's Transfer Area were the most popular COT2 spot, so expect crowds and kill-stealing.
Become a Kerning City citizen at Lv 12. It unlocks Wolbi stars and the Lesser Overall LUK and Lesser Glove Attack scrolls.
Pick maps where your weakest Lucky Seven roll still kills in 1–2 casts at a 100% hit rate. Each character level adds more Accuracy than a point of DEX (+0.5 vs +0.3).
Stand more than 65 px from mobs (jump-attacks help) so your claw throws stars instead of punching.
Max Claw Mastery early: besides the Attack Power, it returns about 25% of thrown stars.
If you play the COT2 Hermit preview again: Lucky Seven is still your boss button, and Avenger is for 3–4 mobs. Shadow Partner doubles star use, so stock up first.
classicChanges: Launch state (official): Founder's Access (Oct 6) and Grand Launch (Oct 21) have only 1st and 2nd job, on Maple Island and Victoria Island, with a max level of 100. Hermit, Orbis and El Nath were COT2-only and are being reworked with no date.

No dice at creation: every stat starts at 4 and you place 9 free AP. Beginners get 9 SP by Lv 10, enough to max all three Beginner skills. HP washing is gone, and an AP Reset resets all stats at once.

Universal combat changes: everyone can crit (base 5%, +20% damage); defense is a percentage reduction; character level counts toward Accuracy; the damage cap is 99,999; most AoEs hit 4 targets. The Aug 11 patch raised post-hit invincibility from 1 s to 1.5 s.
Lucky Seven is 140% x2 (COT1: 120%) with its own fixed multiplier and 50% mastery. Keen Eyes has 15 levels (+200 px). Nimble Body max is 15. Dark Sight is now a toggle.

Claw Mastery gives Attack Power and star recovery instead of Accuracy. Critical Recovery replaces Endure. Drain is 240% with a 12% heal proc (COT1: a heal on every hit). Haste is +30 Speed / +10 Jump (2008: +40/+20).

Hermit (COT2): Alchemist and Meso Up were replaced by Claw Guard and Meso Saver. Avenger is 150% on 4 targets (2008: 180% on 6). The shadow hits for 40%. Flash Jump lost its 3 s cooldown on Aug 11, and its MP cost rose from 60-20 to 70-30 (skill Lv 1-20).

weapons.why: Double Stab, Savage Blow, Assaulter and Band of Thieves need a dagger. At each tier the DEX daggers have 3 more W.ATK than the STR line: Reef Claw 48 → Gephart 58 → Shinkita 68 → Deadly Fin 78 → Kandine 88.

Cass, Sai, Serpent's Coil and Golden River need STR instead of DEX and attack one speed stage faster. At equal stats that's about 5% more damage, but they end up about 1.3% behind once you pay 65 STR, and Lv 70 thief armor still needs 60 DEX. Korean Fan (Lv 40) needs only LUK.
Daggers are one-handed. A shield adds W.DEF and a Guard chance that fully blocks eligible physical hits. Jurgen Wristguard also gives +1 DEX toward Kandine's requirement.
Only on the Sindit route: Lucky Seven until about Lv 40, then an SP Reset into daggers.

builds.summary: A melee dagger thief built on LUK. Savage Blow is the best single-target attack of any Lv 70 2nd job, Steal adds a stun and an Attack Power buff, Haste helps the party, and a shield gives Guard blocks. The COT2 Chief Bandit preview added Flash Jump (new for this class), a mid-air Assaulter dash, a 6-target Band of Thieves and a Meso Explosion whose damage doesn't depend on your gear. The costs are close-range risk, heavy MP use and a busier rotation.

mobbing.why: Launch: Steal (180% on 2 targets) is the only multi-target attack and Savage Blow hits 1, so meowdb's Lv 70 AoE DPS is 3,553 against roughly 7,000–9,000 for most warriors, bowmen and wizards. COT2's Chief Bandit would add Band of Thieves (6 targets) and Meso Explosion.

bossing.why: Launch: Savage Blow (6 x 75%) is the #1 single-target attack of all ten Lv 70 2nd jobs (5,696 DPS, about 342k per minute with Steal's +35 Attack Power kept up), though you fight in melee range. COT2's Assaulter (600%, 2 s stun) would add to it.

mobility.why: Launch: party Haste, Dark Sight and mid-jump attacks give Bandit the same 4.0 mobility as Assassin in meowdb's table, but melee range means walking into every mob. COT2's Chief Bandit would add Flash Jump and the Assaulter dash.

survival.why: Launch: A-grade physical EHP (about 4,600 at Lv 70, #4 of 10), with shield Guard blocks and Nimble Recovery. But magic EHP is only B, and the shortest range in the game means you trade hits constantly. COT2's Meso Guard and Chakra would add 50% damage blocking and Dark Sight healing.

funding.why: Launch: no ammo to buy, but melee means steady HP-potion use and Savage Blow costs 28 MP (about 139 damage per MP on its own, 148 with Steal upkeep, #7 of 10 in meowdb's tier table). The popular Sindit route also needs a Cash Shop SP Reset Scroll with no confirmed price. COT2's Meso Guard would also spend mesos on every blocked hit.

party.why: Launch: Haste plus Steal's 1.5 s stun on up to 2 mobs (meowdb support 3.0).

stats.creation: No dice roll. Every stat starts at 4 and you place 9 free AP on the creation screen. Put all 9 into LUK (4/4/4/13).
stats.rule: LUK is your damage stat with any dagger. Add DEX (or STR for STR daggers) only to meet your next weapon's or armor's requirement, then put everything else into LUK.

plan.do: All AP into LUK. meowdb says 1st job has no stat requirement in Classic; mapleclassic.wiki and henesys.gg still list 25 DEX, so check before you skip DEX completely.

Pure dagger: add DEX only for the next dagger (Triple-Tipped Zamadar at Lv 17 needs 11 DEX / 31 LUK; Reef Claw at Lv 30 needs 25 DEX / 60 LUK). Sindits follow the claw steps instead (15/20/25/30 DEX).
Add 1 DEX and 4 LUK per level (Gephart needs 35 DEX at Lv 40, Shinkita 45 at Lv 50, Deadly Fin 55 at Lv 60). Stop adding DEX at about 61 base DEX.
All 5 AP into LUK, reaching about 61 base DEX / 301 base LUK at Lv 70 (meowdb plan). Kandine's 65 DEX comes from gear: Jurgen Wristguard +1, Blue Mystique Shoes +3.
All AP into LUK.

variants.name: Sindit (Lucky Seven, then SP Reset)
variants.how: Level 10–40 on the Assassin's Lucky Seven plan (same 1st-job SP and claw DEX steps). Put Bandit SP into Haste (20 by Lv 37) and Nimble Recovery (8 by Lv 39). At about Lv 40–41, use an SP Reset Scroll: 1st job becomes Nimble Body 15 / Disorder 20 / Dark Sight 6 / Double Stab 20 (or Disorder 6 / Dark Sight 20), and 2nd job becomes Dagger Mastery 20 / Dagger Booster 1 / Savage Blow 10. Switch to Savage Blow at about Lv 42.
variants.tradeoff: The fastest and safest way through Lv 10–40, and the most popular COT2 path per meowdb and a dedicated YouTube guide. It needs an SP Reset Scroll, a Cash Shop item with no confirmed launch price (COT shop items were nearly free), and the claw/star money is wasted after the reset.

variants.name: STR daggers ('Str-dit')
variants.how: Use Cass, Sai, Serpent's Coil or Golden River and put AP into STR to meet their requirement. Korean Fan (Lv 40, LUK-only) covers the 40s.
variants.tradeoff: One attack-speed stage faster (Golden River 90 vs Kandine 83 Savage Blows per minute) but 3 less W.ATK. After paying 65 STR it ends about 1.3% behind, and Lv 70 thief armor still needs 60 DEX. meowdb strongly advises against it; one community build guide (Citrus) champions it.

variants.name: Low-DEX / DEXless Bandit
variants.how: Keep base DEX low (25, or even 4 in some community builds) and get dagger DEX from scrolled gear. Use Korean Fan in the 40s.
variants.tradeoff: More LUK, but it depends on expensive gear with fragile requirements; total DEX drives both equip requirements and accuracy.

variants.name: COT2 3rd job: Meso Explosion before Band of Thieves
variants.how: Assaulter 30 → Pickpocket 3 → Meso Explosion 30 → Pickpocket 20, then Band of Thieves. One COT2 Lv 100 build was Assaulter 30 / Pickpocket 20 / Meso Explosion 30 / Chakra 10 / Flash Jump 1.
variants.tradeoff: Gear-independent burst on bosses and packs (up to 15 drops, one target each), but it needs drops on the ground and a crouching cast. The other Lv 100 COT2 build went Band of Thieves first (Assaulter 30 / Band of Thieves 30 / Chakra 30 / Meso Guard 1) for steadier 6-target mobbing.

skillInfo.what: +1 Accuracy and +1 Avoid per level (+15/+15 at max). 3 points unlock Keen Eyes.

skillInfo.what: Hits for 100% weapon damage and debuffs one enemy: −25 Attack Power and −5 W.DEF for 30 s at max. 3 points unlock Dark Sight.

skillInfo.classicChange: Changed from a timed buff (200 s at max in 2008) to a toggle.

skillInfo.what: 2 stars at 140% each (16 MP), 200–400 px, with a fixed 50% mastery. Sindits level with it until about Lv 40.
skillInfo.classicChange: COT1 was 120%, raised to 140% in COT2 (2008: 150%).

skillInfo.what: Mastery level 10, +20% crit rate and a 20% chance to ignore knockback (dagger only).

skillInfo.what: +2 attack-speed stages at every level. 300 s for 10 HP / 10 MP at Lv 20. Needs Dagger Mastery 5.
skillInfo.classicChange: Max duration is now 300 s (2008: 200 s).

skillInfo.what: After you dodge an attack, recover 10% HP and 10% MP (100% chance at Lv 20), then a 30 s lockout.
skillInfo.classicChange: New Classic skill. The old Endure regen passive is gone.

skillInfo.what: Party buff: +30 Speed and +10 Jump for 300 s (35 MP). Doesn't stack with an Assassin's Haste.
skillInfo.classicChange: Weaker but longer than in 2008 (+40 / +20 for 200 s).

skillInfo.what: Hits up to 2 monsters for 180% (24 MP) with a 90% steal chance. On success: 1.5 s stun and +35 Attack Power for 30 s (about +8.7% damage). Each monster can only be stolen from once. Needs Haste 5.
skillInfo.classicChange: COT2 raised it to 2 targets (from 1) and cut damage to 180% (from 200%). In 2008 it was 40% steal and 100% damage with no buff.

skillInfo.what: Up to 6 dagger hits: 4 hits at skill Lv 1–10, 5 at Lv 11–20, 6 at Lv 21–30. Lv 30 = 6 x 75% (450%) for 28 MP. Usable mid-jump.

skillInfo.what: Passive. Using Dark Sight at 50% HP or less restores 45% HP over 3 s (30 s lockout from skill Lv 21) and cuts Dark Sight's cost by 10 MP.

skillInfo.what: Toggle. Blocks 50% of incoming damage and charges mesos equal to 40% of the blocked amount (35 MP). Turns off if you run out of mesos. Needs Chakra 3.

skillInfo.what: Toggle. Eligible hits have a 60% chance to drop mesos, up to 15 drops on the map (30 MP).
skillInfo.classicChange: Now a toggle, and the prerequisite flipped: Meso Explosion requires Pickpocket 3. In 2008, Pickpocket required Meso Explosion 3.

skillInfo.what: Crouch to detonate up to 15 of your own meso drops (40 MP). Each drop hits one monster for about 750–1,500 at Lv 30 regardless of your stats; a 50-meso drop does about 92% of a 10,000-meso bag. Mesos from other players' kills don't count.
skillInfo.classicChange: Now unlocked by Pickpocket (reversed prerequisite); the damage formula is Classic's own.

skillInfo.what: Dashes through one target in front for 600% and moves you behind it, with a 100% chance of a 2 s stun (35 MP). Usable mid-jump.
skillInfo.classicChange: Stronger than 2008 (450%, 80% stun). The Aug 11 COT2 patch made it usable while jumping.

skillInfo.what: A second jump in mid-air. 70 MP at Lv 1, 30 MP at Lv 20; 304 to 410 px. No cooldown. Needs Assaulter 5.

skillInfo.what: On hit, summoned thieves sweep the area in front: 220% on up to 6 targets at Lv 30 (50 MP).
skillInfo.classicChange: Keeps a 6-target cap while most Classic AoEs dropped to 4. In 2008: 210% with 5 'other selves'.

gear: DEX daggers: Reef Claw (Lv 30, 48 W.ATK; 25 DEX / 60 LUK) → Halfmoon Zamadar (35, Weaponcrafting 7, longer 86 px reach) → Gephart (40, Weaponcrafting 8) → Shinkita (50, no recipe, 86 px reach) → Deadly Fin (60) → Kandine (70, 88 W.ATK; 65 DEX / 140 LUK).
STR / fast line: Cass (30), Korean Fan (40, LUK-only, drops from Lorang), Sai (50, Weaponcrafting 10), Serpent's Coil (60), Golden River (70). One speed stage faster, 3 less W.ATK.
Shield: Jurgen Wristguard (54 W.DEF, 9.7% Guard, +1 DEX; 68 W.DEF / 12% Guard with 7 Lesser scrolls) or Pan Lid (no requirement). Scrolling W.DEF also raises the Guard chance.

Scrolls: W.ATK on gloves and dagger (5 Lesser glove attack scrolls ≈ +5.3% damage, vs +1.2% for crit on the Lv 70 build). LUK on cape, overall and earrings. Female Bandits get Dark Avenger at Lv 35 (+6 LUK, 10 slots).
Lv 70 set used in the COT2 benchmark builds: Kandine and Jurgen Wristguard with White Nightfox, Dark Studded Top and Pants, Gold Rover, Blue Mystique Shoes, Black Gaia Cape, Metal Silver Earrings.
Potions: Red Potion, Meat or Fried Chicken for HP (2 HP per meso) and Orange or Lemon for MP (1 MP per meso). White and Blue Potions are poor value.
strengths: Highest single-target damage of any Lv 70 2nd job (Savage Blow, about 5.7k DPS in meowdb's benchmark).
No ammo costs, and the shield's Guard can fully block physical hits.
Steal: a 2-target stun, a +35 Attack Power buff and item theft in one button.
The COT2 preview made Chief Bandit very mobile (Flash Jump, mid-air Assaulter) and tough for a thief (Meso Guard, Chakra).
Meso Explosion's damage doesn't depend on your gear, and small drops hit almost as hard as big bags.
weaknesses: Shortest reach in the game: you stand in contact range and take hits.
Heavy MP use (Savage Blow 28, Assaulter 35, Band of Thieves 50 MP).
Little AoE before 3rd job, and 3rd job isn't at launch.
Weapon requirements (DEX vs STR daggers) punish late planning. The Sindit route depends on an SP Reset Scroll with no confirmed launch price.
The 3rd-job rotation needs active juggling: Pickpocket drops, crouch for Meso Explosion, Assaulter, Band of Thieves.
tips: Don't reset at Lv 30. Lucky Seven (Sindit) or max Double Stab carries you until about Lv 40–42, when Savage Blow reaches 16–21.
Savage Blow breakpoints: 5 hits at skill Lv 11 and 6 hits at Lv 21. The sixth hit is the one that matters.
Open each pack with Steal on a fresh monster: success gives +35 Attack Power for 30 s and a 1.5 s stun. A monster can only be stolen from once.
When Double Stab and Savage Blow both kill a mob in one cast, use Double Stab: it's about 23% more MP-efficient.
Wear Jurgen Wristguard (its +1 DEX helps toward Kandine's 65) and scroll it for W.DEF to raise Guard procs.
COT2 preview: Meso Explosion only works crouched on the ground and only uses mesos from your own kills or Pickpocket. Assaulter works mid-jump, which makes it a second movement skill.
classicChanges: Launch state (official): Founder's Access (Oct 6) and Grand Launch (Oct 21) have only 1st and 2nd job, on Maple Island and Victoria Island, with a max level of 100. Chief Bandit, Orbis and El Nath were COT2-only and are being reworked with no date.

No dice at creation (stats start at 4, plus 9 free AP). HP washing is gone, and an AP Reset resets all stats at once. Everyone can crit, defense is a percentage reduction, character level counts toward Accuracy, and the damage cap is 99,999.
Double Stab is 160% x2. Dark Sight is a toggle. Dagger Mastery gives crit and knockback resistance instead of Accuracy. Nimble Recovery replaces Endure. Haste is +30 Speed / +10 Jump.
Steal reworked: 2 targets at 180% (COT1: 1 target at 200%), 90% success, and +35 Attack Power plus a stun on success. Savage Blow is 6 x 75%.

Chief Bandit (COT2): gained Flash Jump (needs Assaulter 5; cooldown removed Aug 11). Assaulter is 600% with a 100% stun and works mid-jump since Aug 11. Chakra became a Dark Sight passive. Meso Guard and Pickpocket are toggles. Meso Explosion now needs Pickpocket 3 and hits one target per drop. Shield Mastery is gone. Band of Thieves keeps its 6-target cap.
builds.confidence: High: skill names, max levels, numbers and prerequisites. meowdb (COT2 client data), metaroad's planner and ohmi69's datamine agree; Nexon's Aug 11 notes confirm the Flash Jump and Assaulter changes. High: the 2nd-job order for Lv 30–70 and the AP plan (meowdb's no-reset table; metaroad agrees on Dagger Mastery → Savage Blow first but leaves Steal at 11). 2nd-job SP stops at Lv 70 (121 SP), as in COT2, where SP earned after Lv 70 went to the 3rd-job pool; nothing official covers the launch yet. Medium: the 1st-job leveling order. The end point is meowdb's, the order is inferred, and many COT2 Bandits leveled as Sindits instead. Low-medium: the 3rd-job order, inferred from 9 community COT2 builds that split between Meso Explosion first and Band of Thieves first; there is no guide, and Nexon says 3rd job will be reworked. Medium-high: tier A, the most consistent result across lists, though most lists are low-trust blogs. Not confirmed: the 1st-job DEX requirement. Nothing relies on pre-Big Bang memory; 2008 values come from Ayumilove's 2008 skill lists and appear only in classicChange fields.

tips.text: Expect a slow climb: testers needed about 3–4 hours for Lv 10–20 and 8–9 hours for Lv 20–30.
Hunt what you kill in one or two hits, not the highest level you can reach. Accuracy and damage drop against higher-level monsters, and spells can miss too.
Lemons were the most-used item in both tests; in the second, players went through 3.5M Lemons, 2.6M Red Potions and 2.3M Meat.
Move up a potion tier as your HP grows: around 600–800 max HP, White Potions save clicks and inventory slots.
From about Lv 17 up, many monsters hit 10–25% harder in the second test than in the first (Stirges +13%, Wild Boars +20%, Fire Boars +22%), so pack more potions than you think.
Party up: in the second test a party got +10% EXP with 2 players, +20% with 3 and +30% with 4 to 6 (meowdb's map data). One later write-up claims bigger bonuses.

tips.text: Run KPQ for its rewards and a change of pace; a good grinding party earns more EXP.
If a map is busy, rotate to a quieter backup; metaroad expects launch-day maps to be packed and lists alternatives for every level range.
Grab Pio's chair before you leave Maple Island, board Shanks' boat once you reach Lv 7 (300 mesos), and use the 90% Beginner taxi discount to reach your job town.
Become a citizen of Henesys or Kerning City at Lv 12 for 5–25% off that town’s shops and taxis.
Dying outside a town costs EXP; Nexon's Aug 10 maintenance fixed a bug where it sometimes didn't.
Don't expect EXP boosts in the Cash Shop: Nexon says it intends to avoid selling items that directly raise EXP or make characters stronger.

Plan for a thin Lv 60–100: with Forgotten Hollow and Ossyria closed, the toughest regular monsters on Victoria Island are Wild Kargo (62), Tauromacis (70) and Taurospear (75), all on timed respawns. For EXP, meowdb says to stay on Sleepy Dungeon V or the Wraith subway maps.
